messages:
maya: Quick sync  need a single, crisp front-page line that works for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private while routing leads correctly. Keep headline short, modes in supporting line.

leo: Agreed. Headline draft: "Reliable, production-ready LLM inference"

anika: Short and solid. Supporting line: "Start with our Hosted API, or scale to Dedicated or Private with the same API and controls."

ram: UX idea: three micro-CTAs beneath the line as pills: Start hosted | Enterprise capacity | Learn benchmarks. Each drives different funnels.

maya: Routing plan: 
  - Start hosted -> /signup?utm=frontline&mode=hosted -> Growth onboarding queue
  - Enterprise capacity -> /enterprise?utm=frontline&mode=enterprise -> enterprise form + AE alert
  - Learn benchmarks -> /benchmarks?utm=frontline&mode=bench -> content track

leo: Pill copy suggestions: "Start hosted 1 free credits"; "Enterprise capacity 1 request capacity planning"; "Benchmarks 1 model/latency reports"

anika: Below pills: three short proof points (one sentence each): reliability, cost controls, and ops observability. Keep vague metrics out unless linked to benchmarks.

ram: Webinar promo: 35-minute tech talk + 10 Q&A. Title: "Practical patterns for serving LLMs: efficiency and resiliency". Short blurb for page and social.

maya: Form fields for enterprise funnel: company, role, team size, expected peak qps, compliance needs, checkbox: "Request capacity planning call". Checkbox flags AE.

leo: Add tiny link after headline: "Compare modes -> /compare-modes" for product-oriented folks.

copybot: Reminder scheduled: "Front-page copy sprint" tomorrow 9:30 PT.

maya: Great work. I'll assemble A/B variants and mobile-first frames for the sprint. Thanks.
